title: Why Is Everyone Talking About Amazon Stock? | AMZN Stock Deep Dive Part 2
creator: Parkevtate Vosianc CFA
source_note: Detailed summary generated from video captions; auto-captions garble names/numbers in places
summary: Parkevtate Vosianc CFA answers the question hanging over Amazon: with 2026 AI capex raised to $225 billion and meaningfully more expected next year, will the investment pay back? He relays management's answers from the earnings call, which he reads as positive. CEO Andy Jassy said Amazon continues to accelerate its capex payback - from around five years to 1.5-3 years - so the money comes back faster and the risk falls, and with multi-year orders in hand (for example $100 billion of spend against $150 billion of orders) each data centre is a calculated decision. Management also says it now has even more conviction than before that AWS will become a much larger revenue and free-cash-flow business than imagined a couple of years ago. He contrasts this with US electric-vehicle makers, which have come back to investors with cutbacks and layoffs. He adds a forgotten tailwind: about 85% of global IT is still on-premise, a 10-20 year migration to cloud that keeps boosting AWS demand beyond AI. He is a shareholder; no explicit buy, hold or sell verdict and no fair value is stated, so no call-event is recorded; his tracked AMZN stance remains BUY (2 November).
